about: Every UI control, the backend RPC(s) it triggers (see scenarios.json for the checked backend behaviour), and what must be visible afterwards. Claude can walk this file with the browser tools: run the UI in preview (cd app/ui; npm run dev; open http://127.0.0.1:5173/?demo - mock gateway) or in the real app. 'find' is how to locate the control (accessible name / title / visible text).
how_to_test: 1. Backend truth: python scripts/e2e_runner.py (175 steps against a throwaway gateway; must be all PASS).
2. UI wiring: for each entry, locate the control with 'find', click it, confirm 'expect_ui', and (real gateway only) confirm the 'rpc' was audited as listed in scenarios.json.
3. Console must stay free of errors (read_console_messages onlyErrors). Mock-only limits: no mic, no native dialogs, no TPM.
